_note: Memory Quest (lesson 5) match-the-pairs cards. Level 1 pairs are for everyone; level 2 pairs are added for ages 9-11. Short lines: the card and the reminder are read by young children. Draft for expert review in week 7.

items.meaning: My body: only with my OK
items.remember: Nobody touches Keza's body without Keza's OK.
Family and friends can come close. Keza can still say no.
People Keza doesn't know stay in green.
Touching secrets are never okay. Keza always tells.
A surprise is happy and told soon. A worrying secret is not a surprise.
No photos, no school name. Show a grown-up.
